values.name: Accountability
values.description: Owning the outcomes of your actions and taking initiative ahead of problems instead of just reacting to them.

values.name: Adaptability
values.description: Adjusting quickly and effectively when circumstances change.

values.name: Adventurousness
values.description: Seeking out new challenges and risks rather than staying in familiar territory.

values.name: Ambition
values.description: Aiming high, working toward bigger goals, and holding yourself to the highest possible standard.

values.name: Analytical thinking
values.description: Reasoning things through clearly, keeping sight of the wider context, and wanting to understand how and why things work.

values.name: Assertiveness
values.description: Trusting your own judgment and stating your position confidently, even under pressure.

values.name: Authenticity
values.description: Acting in line with who you really are, with your own distinct style, not a performance.

values.name: Autonomy
values.description: Having the freedom to decide and act without relying on others.

values.name: Boundaries
values.description: Knowing and communicating your limits clearly.

values.name: Care
values.description: Paying real attention to others' wellbeing and actively helping and supporting them.

values.name: Communication
values.description: Expressing ideas clearly and concisely, and genuinely listening to others.

values.name: Composure
values.description: Staying present, calm, level-headed, and self-controlled, rather than on autopilot or under pressure.

values.name: Connection
values.description: Building genuine relationships and standing together with those around you.

values.name: Consistency
values.description: Behaving the same reliable way over time, not just when convenient.

values.name: Courage
values.description: Acting despite fear, danger, or an uncertain outcome.

values.name: Creativity
values.description: Generating original ideas and turning them into something new.

values.name: Discipline
values.description: Sticking to what needs to be done, even without external pressure, and working carefully and thoroughly.

values.name: Enthusiasm
values.description: Bringing visible energy, passion, and excitement to your work.

values.name: Fairness
values.description: Applying the same fair, impartial standards to everyone.

values.name: Friendliness
values.description: Greeting and treating others in a warm, approachable way and seeking a smooth, low-conflict way of working together.

values.name: Growth
values.description: Continuously developing your skills, knowledge, and understanding.

values.name: Honesty
values.description: Saying what you actually think, plainly and without pretense.

values.name: Humility
values.description: Keeping your own achievements and importance in perspective.

values.name: Influence
values.description: Being able to shape outcomes and other people's thinking.

values.name: Integrity
values.description: Acting consistently with your values, protecting what's entrusted to you, and behaving in a way that earns others' trust.

values.name: Joy
values.description: Bringing genuine delight, playfulness, and humor into everyday work.

values.name: Leadership
values.description: Guiding others toward a shared goal and giving them the confidence and means to grow.

values.name: Openness
values.description: Being receptive to new ideas, feedback, and different perspectives or backgrounds.

values.name: Patience
values.description: Allowing things and people the time they need, and letting go of grudges.

values.name: Perceptiveness
values.description: Picking up on subtle cues, feelings, and needs, and assessing situations practically and accurately.

values.name: Perseverance
values.description: Pushing through obstacles and hardship without giving up.

values.name: Purpose
values.description: Being driven by a clear sense of why your work matters, with a clear picture of a desired future.

values.name: Recognition
values.description: Actively noticing and acknowledging what others contribute, and appreciating what is going well.

values.name: Reliability
values.description: Consistently following through on commitments so others can count on you.

values.name: Respect
values.description: Treating others with basic courtesy and consideration, regardless of status.

values.name: Structure
values.description: Organizing work into a clear, predictable order.

values.name: Teamwork
values.description: Working effectively and cooperatively with others toward one shared result.

values.name: Wealth
values.description: Pursuing financial security and material success.
